verdict.rationale: First-party docs say running `fly launch` inside a project's source directory creates, configures, and, for most apps, deploys a new application in one command, using the official flyctl CLI. Community reports of deploys failing or leaving instances stuck temper confidence, but they describe reliability problems, not the absence of the capability. Missing for 10: scaffolding of project code from scratch (`fly launch` works on existing source), deploy guaranteed for all app types (docs say only "for most apps"), and independent hands-on corroboration that the single-command flow works reliably.
